## Script command examples

```bash
# 1) Omit output -> default folder + autogenerated name
python3 scripts/generate_image.py --model-preset flash31 "A peaceful zen garden"

# 2) Explicit file path
python3 scripts/generate_image.py --model-preset pro3 "Mountain landscape" "./wallpapers/mountains.png"

# 3) Directory path -> autogenerated name in that directory
python3 scripts/generate_image.py --model-preset flash31 "Landing page visual" "./src/assets/heroes"

# 4) High resolution
python3 scripts/generate_image.py --size 2K --model-preset flash31 "Detailed cityscape"

# 5) Custom model
python3 scripts/generate_image.py --model gemini-3-pro-image-preview "Product photo"

# 6) Model preset
python3 scripts/generate_image.py --model-preset pro3 "Studio portrait"
```
